question: What becomes dear to the yoginīs through enjoyment liberation and great accomplishment?
premises: bhukti mukti mahā siddhiḥ are named
inference: The verse identifies the one who attains these as dear to the yoginīs.
uncertainties: exact syntactic relation of mahā to siddhiḥ
plain_english: Enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment make one dear to the yoginīs.
